On Friday, February 14th, the United States Securities and Exchange Commission requested a 28-day extension of its deadline to respond to Coinbase’s appeal. This latest move represents an interesting development in the protracted legal battle between the regulatory agency and the US’ largest crypto exchange.

In its latest filing, the SEC asked the court to extend its deadline to respond to crypto exchange Coinbase’s appeal from February 14 to March 14. Both parties have been at loggerheads on whether or not digital assets should be classified as securities.
